title: Run the whole Showmob release loop
summary: Use a final knowledge check and release worksheet to rehearse one safe artifact change.

blocks.title: Prove you can follow one page from edit to production
blocks.body: The goal is not memorizing web vocabulary. It is reading the actual line: change structured content, validate the contract, build the app, review the exact commit, merge it, verify its production deployment, and inspect the live result.

blocks.title: Practice scenario
blocks.body: A new preview lesson needs one compact table and one knowledge check. It uses existing widgets, so the change should be content-first. Plan the files, gates, review evidence and production readback without adding new application behavior.

blocks.heading: 1. Where does the lesson belong?
blocks.prompt: Which change is the normal starting point?
options: Add and register a schema-valid JSON artifact
blocks.explanation: Existing widgets make this a content change. Add the JSON and register it in the library.

blocks.heading: 2. What are the local gates?
blocks.prompt: Which pair must pass before opening or merging the PR?
options: Validation tests and npm run build
A theme switch and localStorage reset
blocks.explanation: Validation checks the content contract; the build checks types and production bundling. Visual review is additional evidence.

blocks.heading: 3. When is production done?
options: The merge commit is on main, its production deployment succeeded, and the canonical live page was inspected
blocks.explanation: Done is a source-to-live readback, not a single intermediate status.

items.label: Scope the change
items.detail: Name the artifact file, registry import and any docs that must change.

items.label: Run contract validation
items.detail: Record the test command and pass count.

items.label: Run production build
items.detail: Record npm run build and the output summary.

items.label: Open the PR
items.detail: Write the title, summary, validation evidence and explicit follow-ups.

items.label: Inspect preview
items.detail: Check the exact branch at desktop and 390px; use the changed interaction.

items.label: Merge the reviewed head
items.detail: Record the PR URL and merge commit SHA.

items.label: Verify production
items.detail: Bind Vercel success to the merge SHA, inspect the live page and record its canonical URL.

blocks.heading: The finished part is the live, verified artifact
blocks.body: Source, tests, build, PR, merge and deployment are stations. The accepted result is the canonical page that opens, reads and behaves as intended.

blocks.heading: Repository source: the complete contract
blocks.caption: Use the architecture, widget catalog, README and contribution guide together when the work crosses content, renderer, build and deployment boundaries.
